steps.title: Open the apps menu
steps.body: This walkthrough starts the first time you open the menu. Click the button with the nine dots, or rest the pointer on it for a moment. A click keeps the menu open.
steps.task: Keys: Enter opens the menu with focus inside it, Escape closes it and puts focus back on the button.

steps.title: Your apps in a row
steps.body: The apps you use most are at the top: icon, name and one line on what the app does. The app you are working in is marked. Tab and the arrow keys move you through the list.

steps.title: More and fewer
steps.body: More apps unfolds the rest of your apps, Fewer apps folds them away. The line is the border: drag an app from below the line to above it and it stays with your first apps. Drag one down and it goes to More.
steps.task: Keys: Alt with Arrow up moves the focused app up across the line, Arrow down puts it below.

steps.title: Put them in your order
steps.body: Pick an app up and drop it where you want it. Your order is saved and follows you to every browser you sign in to. After a move you hear the new place, for example Portaliq moved to place 4 of 14.
steps.task: Keys: Alt with Arrow left or up, one place earlier; Arrow right or down, one place later.

steps.title: Pin an app to the top bar
steps.body: Drag an app from the menu to the top bar and drop it on the dashed slot. It is then always one click away. Drag a pinned app off the bar to unpin it. You can pin five.
steps.task: Keys: Alt+P pins the focused app, or unpins it.

steps.title: Create
steps.body: Start a new document, spreadsheet, presentation or whiteboard here. The file lands in your own folder and opens at once. More shows everything else Nextcloud can create.

steps.title: Menu settings
steps.body: Here you choose which apps you see, in which order and which are pinned, and switch the buttons under Create on or off. Administrators set the default for everyone here.
steps.task: Hint: Want to see the walkthrough again? Menu settings, Replay walkthrough. Or from Help in your account menu.
